query: GET https://arxiv.org/e-print/2210.01147 (Ristea et al. 2022, MNRAS 517, 2677, 'The SAMI Galaxy Survey: physical drivers of stellar-gas kinematic misalignments in the nearby Universe'); verbatim transcription of Table A1
measurement_or_model: MEASUREMENT. Fractions of SAMI DR3 galaxies binned by the measured |DeltaPA_stars-gas| from fits to the observed stellar and ionised-gas velocity fields. No DM halo, no Jeans/JAM model.
note: AGGREGATE FRACTIONS ONLY - no per-galaxy IDs in the arXiv source. Parent sample = 1445 SAMI DR3 galaxies with BOTH stellar and ionised-gas kinematics measured. 169 misaligned (>30 deg); 95 in the 'unstable' 30-150 deg band (this band CONTAINS the ~90 deg polar systems but the paper does not separate them); 53 counter-rotating (150-180 deg); 1276 aligned (<30 deg).
